lines.t: A fully godly and blameless life,
Worthy is The Lamb of our Sacrifice
Gave Himself up willingly,
To be crucified and to torturing
Ohhh, the agony,
He chose to endure for you and me,
A love that this world has never seen
His life is still pouring out at the tree
Down from the cross The Lamb was received
The sight of His wounds His friends closely see
Body prepared and brought to the grave
Soldiers seal the tomb then they watch and wait
Then after three days and three nights
Guards became like dead at the angel's sight
The angels began to roll back the stone
Victory declared as He arose
There is no stain, His blood can't clean
There is no sin, too great that He
Cannot forgive, if you repent and believe
Forgiveness and Life you will receive
